name: Diversicon
blurb: A diversity-focused, volunteer-run Minnesota science fiction convention with local Guests of Honor, panels and an auction.
notes: diversicon.org auto-redirects to the current edition's own subdomain. As of this check it redirects to diversicon33.mnstf.org (Diversicon 33, already held July 24-26, 2026 in Plymouth, MN, not Saint Paul as in the batch note - venue rotates). The next edition's subdomain, diversicon34.mnstf.org, resolves but is an empty, not-yet-uploaded DreamHost placeholder, so no 2027 date/venue is announced yet; editions is left empty with Diversicon 33 recorded as 'last'. Guests were not collected since that lineup (Peg Kerr, Adam Stemple) belongs to the already-completed 2026 edition.
